Thanks Anna — good context. We have two pragmatic approaches that customers use for exactly this scenario: 

1) Pro-rata immediate top-up + co-term at renewal
   - Add capacity now and invoice a pro-rated charge for Apr–Oct (or remainder of the current billing period).
   - At renewal (Oct 31) we fold the uplift into the annual commit so future billing aligns with your renewal cadence.
   - Typical recovery pattern: one invoice for the pro-rated portion, then normal monthly billing.

2) Staged voucher / quarterly bridge (recommended for smoothing)
   - We issue a voucher (pre-paid credit) sized to cover the uplift for N months. Vouchers are redeemed on invoice and can be invoiced in quarterly tranches.
   - At renewal, unused voucher value can either convert to committed capacity (if you want) or be refunded per contract terms.
   - Allows you to smooth spend across quarters while avoiding an immediate long-term commit.

Quick pricing vignette (rough numbers to move the discussion):
- Estimated uplift: 200k token units / month -> ~ $12,000/month list (depends on model mix).
- Option 1 pro-rata Apr–Oct (7 months) -> one pro-rated invoice ~ $42k plus normal monthly thereafter.
- Option 2 staged voucher (2 quarters) -> invoice quarterly, blended discount available (we can usually offer 10–12% blended if you accept quarterly invoicing and a short staged commitment).

Action items from my side: draft mutual action plan, send proforma invoice and amendment template, and provide SOC 2 link. If you confirm preferred option I’ll loop Sales Ops and Finance to generate the amendment and proforma.

Does Option 2 look closer to what you want?

Best,

Irene / team — I ran the numbers with Finance. Two recommended commercial paths (both are doable):

A) Staged voucher — quarterly invoicing (recommended for smoothing)
   - Voucher volume: covers 200k token units/month for 6 months (Mar–Aug window).
   - Invoice schedule: Q2 invoice (cover Apr–Jun) and Q3 invoice (cover Jul–Sep), each invoiced up front for the quarter.
   - Pricing: List $12k/mo -> $72k total for 6 months. We can offer 12% blended discount if they accept the quarterly pre-pay (-> $63,360 total).
   - Co-term: remaining voucher value upon Oct renewal can be converted into committed capacity or credited to account; no penalty if converted to commit at renewal.

B) Pro-rata add and co-term at renewal (simpler, less discount)
   - Immediate pro-rated charge for Apr–Oct remainder, then folded into Oct renewal commit.
   - Pricing: list pro-rate ~ $42k for Apr–Oct. Minimal discount (3–5%) since it’s short term.

Notes: Legal will need to approve amendment language for voucher redemption and conversion at co-term. I’ve attached a sample amendment template we use for similar deals.

If Lumen wants maximum smoothing and predictability, A) is our recommended path. I’ll prepare a proforma and sample amendment once you confirm.
